verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs list a page titled "Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle," and Data Privacy Controls document forwarding rules that stop events before they reach destinations. That shows some first-party in-pipeline transformation and filtering, but the evidence is a page title plus a privacy-scoped filter, with nothing showing custom code or functions. Missing for 10: any evidence of user-authored code or functions in the pipeline, documented enrichment, detail on transformation mechanics beyond a page title, general-purpose (non-consent) event filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations

citations.quote: Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
